title: Faderpunk community app catalog
description: One entry per accepted community app. appId is permanent once assigned — never reassign or reuse one, even if an app is removed. The manual entry for the same app lives in manual-tab.json, cross-referenced by this same appId — not a path field here.

appId.description: Reserved range for community apps. Official apps use 1-99. Also the linking key into manual-tab.json.

module.description: Must match the Rust module name in apps/<module>.rs.
